claim: Social media management platform for scheduling, automating and analysing content; cloud and open-source editions
Stack: Next.js, NestJS, Prisma with PostgreSQL by default, Temporal; Redis in self-hosted setup
Public API, Node SDK, n8n custom node and Make.com integration
Docker Compose install; frontend at port 4007, Temporal at port 8080
Install menu lists Docker Compose, Docker and Helm
Self-hosted: unlimited channels, posts and members; own developer apps with approval that can take weeks for Meta, YouTube, TikTok
Analytics require your own app credentials; AI features require your own keys; you pull images and run migrations
AGPL-3.0 licence; same core features in cloud and open source
